contracts.lifetime: Owned by one disposable kernel session
contracts.cancellation: Synchronous public design-time API has no CancellationToken; caller checks before STA dispatch; running hosted callbacks require worker deadline/termination
contracts.reentrancy: Synchronous events may call read APIs; recursive service construction/designer creation is refused; callers must not start nested graph mutations
contracts.refusal: Unavailable service returns null and records its named capability; unsupported operations throw before mutation
contracts.scope: Session-owned named components and design-mode sites; no workspace or window ownership.
